claims.claim: 58.4-second local video covers gallery and one double-matrix correlation workflow
claims.limits: Video publish date unknown; audio transcription corrected against frames.

claims.claim: 54 drawing cards across 15 plotting categories; 52 unique homepage drawing paths; 8 courses separate
claims.limits: Three tree cards share tvBOT portal; counts are not algorithms or passed tests.

claims.claim: 51 of 52 unique drawing paths return 200; bar_with_line_plot.html returns 404
claims.limits: HTTP status does not validate full module behavior.

claims.claim: Both precomputed r/P matrices and raw double-matrix correlation requests are implemented
claims.limits: Raw input numerical computation not independently tested.

claims.claim: Precomputed r upload also calls /ChiPlot/heatmap for clustering
PCA/PCoA/NMDS/CCA/RDA and Mantel expose data analysis requests
claims.limits: Backend algorithms and numerical accuracy not audited.

claims.claim: CDD, MEME, MCScanX, volcano and enrichment generally visualize upstream results
claims.limits: Circos has a FASTA-derived GC calculation branch.

claims.claim: Tree layouts, edits and multi-layer annotation supported in docs and paper
claims.limits: 26 annotation types is 2023 paper scope; current total not asserted.

claims.claim: Default double-matrix example rendered; edited legend exported and recovered in SVG
claims.limits: 32577 bytes; 82 rect; 25 text; embedded 20x200 PNG gradient. One example only.

claims.claim: Default example drawing-state save showed No user data!
evidence: Browser CUA observation in task transcript
claims.limits: No uploaded-user-data save/restore loop tested; not a general failure claim.

claims.claim: Default PCA scatter rendered with PC1 92.46% and PC2 5.31%; controls visible
evidence: Browser CUA observation in task transcript
claims.limits: Default example only; no independent numerical validation.

claims.claim: SVG is downloaded from a browser Blob; PDF/EPS/PNG send SVG to server conversion
My Trees page says guest files kept for three months and account permanent storage forthcoming
Public sample edit/SVG available without login/payment; paid courses separate; archive CC BY 4.0
claims.limits: No permanent free promise; archive license cannot be generalized to all current site code.

claims.claim: AB1 viewer and KO-to-pathway tool are separate server-assisted tools
claims.limits: No private samples uploaded; database freshness unknown.

review_corrections: Path A server clustering made explicit
Mantel methods and data contracts added
Circle Packing narrowed to flat value/category data
